title: 第163章 往昔第162章 记忆消退
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
“为什么？”月临寒轻声重复了一遍她方才的问题，墨色的眼眸平静地注视着她，反问道，“你呢？经历了这么多，与他们一同修炼、战斗、欢笑流泪，你现在还认为，这只是一本小说的世界吗？”
宁苒苒闻言一怔，下意识地回想这段时间的点点滴滴——唐三递来的袖箭、小舞叽叽喳喳的陪伴、姐姐宁荣荣别扭的关心、史莱克伙伴们并肩作战的热血……这些真实的触感、鲜活的情感，怎么可能是虚构的？
她略一思索，瞳孔骤然收缩，声音带着几分艰涩：“你什么意思？难道这里不是小说世界？可这里发生的一切，明明都和我知道的原着剧情一模一样！”
“除此之外，不也有你不知道的变数吗？”月临寒光着脚悬浮在地面上，衣摆随着无形的气流轻轻飘动。他缓缓飘到飘窗边，落座在宁苒苒方才坐过的位置，动作轻盈得如同一片羽毛。
“小说之所以是小说，是因为所有情节都会循着既定轨迹发展。而你，小丫头，你的出现就是最大的变数。当一本小说出现了变数，原本的轨迹便会被推翻、重组，你觉得，重组之后的故事，还会是你记忆中的模样吗？”
宁苒苒怔怔地站在原地，脑海里一片混乱。她喃喃自语，声音微弱得几乎听不见：“如果这里不是我所知道的那个斗罗大陆，那这里又是哪里？”
“不，这里确实是你熟悉的斗罗大陆。”月临寒的目光越过她，望向窗外静止的街道，“只是，新的变数已经让一切都变成了全新的故事。就像一根主线分出了无数根支线，这些支线通向何方，没有人能预知，包括你，也包括我。”
他转过头，斜睨了宁苒苒一眼，墨色的眼眸深邃如古井，不起半分波澜，声音清冷得像是淬了冰：“从你重生在这个世界的那一刻起，你就不再是旁观者，而是局中人。天道自有其运行的法则，它会收回本不该属于局中人的东西，这是必然，无人能改。”
“可是……”宁苒苒用力咬住下唇，贝齿几乎要嵌进柔软的唇肉里，眼底迅速泛起一层薄薄的水光，像蒙了雾的琉璃，“若只是忘记那些所谓的剧情走向也就罢了，为什么连前世的记忆都要一并剥夺？那些记忆里，有哭有笑，有痛有暖，无论好坏，都是组成我的一部分啊！”
“忘记不好吗？”月临寒微微蹙起眉头，修长的指尖无意识地轻捻，语气里带着一丝不易察觉的困惑，似乎完全无法理解她的执着，“我没记错的话，你的前世并没有多少愉快的回忆，那些颠沛流离，那些身不由己，难道不是负累？既然如此，为什么不愿彻底忘记，重新开始？”
“忘记？”宁苒苒猛地抬起头，泪水在眼眶里打着转，晶莹剔透，却被她硬生生逼得没有落下，长长的睫毛微微颤抖，像振翅欲飞的蝶。
她看着月临寒那道虚虚实实、仿佛随时会随风飘散的身影，声音带着几分哽咽，又透着几分不容置疑的坚定，“忘记了前世一切的宁苒苒，还会是宁苒苒吗？不过是一个空有躯壳的陌生人罢了。”
“是，我承认，我前世的记忆里确实没有多少愉快的记忆，那些日子苦得像是泡在黄连水里。”宁苒苒的目光灼灼，直勾勾地看着他，一字一句掷地有声，“但是那又怎么样？正是那些破碎的、疼痛的、甚至不堪的过往，才拼凑出了独一无二的我。拥有所有记忆的我才是我，这才是真正的宁苒苒。”
月临寒静静地看着她，那双深不见底的眸子里，翻涌着宁苒苒看不懂的复杂情绪，像是悲悯，又像是心疼，还有一丝难以言喻的愧疚。
半晌，他缓缓伸出手，明明只是一道没有实体的虚影，指尖穿透了她额前的碎发，感觉不到任何真实的触感，但是宁苒苒的心头却奇异地一暖，仿佛真的有一片温热的掌心，轻轻覆在了她的头顶。
月临寒的神色染上了一层淡淡的哀伤，那双总是清冷的眸子，此刻竟像是蒙了一层霜雪，他声音低沉沙哑，像是从遥远的时光深处传来：“对不起……都是我当初的疏忽，才让你在那个陌生的异世界，孤苦无依地吃了这么多年的苦。”
宁苒苒猛地瞪大了眼睛，瞳孔微微收缩，满心的震惊让她几乎忘记了呼吸，嘴唇翕动着，好半天才找回自己的声音：“你……你这话是什么意思？你认识我？在我来到斗罗大陆之前，你就认识我？”
月临寒轻轻点了点头，苍白的面容上，神色愈发柔和，带着几分追忆的怅然：“八十年前，我便预感到自己的神力在日渐溃散，天道轮回，我本就是顺应天命而生，也该顺应天命而逝。直到某天，我在潜心闭关中突然得到了天道的启示，它说，我尚有一段因果未了，需寻一个继承人，承接我的神位，也了结这段尘缘。”
“我用窥天镜遍观诸天万界，看过了无数人的生老病死、悲欢离合，却始终没有找到那个契合的继承人。”月临寒的声音缓缓流淌，带着岁月沉淀的沧桑。
“直到那一天，我的至交好友前来探望，见我终日守着窥天镜愁眉不展，他随口一句‘与其寻遍万里，不如求诸己身’，才点醒了困在局中的我。所以……我便狠下心，抽走了自己的一根肋骨。”

“我将那根肋骨置于养神莲台之上，以自己的心头精血日日浇灌，再辅以毕生神力小心蕴养。这一养，就是整整五十年。”月临寒的目光落在宁苒苒的脸上，带着近乎温柔的缱绻，“直到……”
他的话语微微一顿，宁苒苒的心也跟着提了起来。月临寒的眼睛平静地看着她，那目光太过深邃，仿佛能看透她的灵魂，宁苒苒的心脏像是被一只无形的手攥紧，在那一瞬间停止了跳动，连呼吸都变得滞涩。
content_en:
"Why?" Yue Linhan repeated her question softly, looking at her calmly with dark eyes, and asked, "What about you? After so much, practicing with them, fighting, laughing and crying, do you still think that this is just the world of a novel?"
Ning Ranran was startled when she heard this, and subconsciously recalled every detail of this period - the sleeve arrows handed by Tang San, Xiao Wu's chirping company, her sister Ning Rongrong's awkward concern, the enthusiasm of Shrek's friends fighting side by side... How could these real touches and vivid emotions be fictional?
She thought for a moment, her pupils suddenly shrank, and her voice was a bit difficult: "What do you mean? Isn't this the world of a novel? But everything that happens here is obviously exactly the same as the original plot I know!"
"Besides, aren't there variables that you don't know about?" Yue Linhan's bare feet were suspended on the ground, and the hem of her clothes fluttered gently with the invisible air current. He slowly floated to the bay window and sat down where Ning Ranran had been sitting just now, his movements as light as a feather.
"The reason why a novel is a novel is that all plots will develop along a predetermined trajectory. And you, little girl, your appearance is the biggest variable. When variables appear in a novel, the original trajectory will be overturned and reorganized. Do you think the story after the reorganization will still be the same as you remember it?"
Ning Ranran stood there blankly, her mind in confusion. She murmured to herself, her voice so weak that it was almost inaudible: "If this is not the Douluo Continent I know, then where is this place?"
"No, this is indeed the Douluo Continent you are familiar with." Yue Linhan looked past her and looked at the still streets outside the window, "It's just that the new variables have turned everything into a brand new story. It's like a main line branching off into countless branches. No one can predict where these branches will lead, including you and me."
He turned his head and glanced sideways at Ning Ranran. His dark eyes were as deep as ancient wells, without any waves, and his voice was as cold as ice: "From the moment you are reborn in this world, you are no longer a bystander, but a player in the game. The law of heaven has its own laws. It will take back things that should not belong to the people in the game. This is inevitable and no one can change it."
"But..." Ning Ranran bit her lower lip hard, and her teeth were almost embedded in the soft lip flesh. A thin layer of water quickly appeared in her eyes, like foggy glass, "If it is just to forget those so-called plot directions, why should we also deprive the memories of the past life? In those memories, there is crying, laughter, pain and warmth, no matter good or bad, they are all part of me!"
"Isn't it good to forget?" Yue Linhan frowned slightly, twirling her slender fingertips unconsciously, with a hint of imperceptible confusion in her tone, as if she couldn't understand her persistence at all, "If I remember correctly, you didn't have many happy memories in your previous life. Those wanderings and those involuntarily, aren't they a burden? In this case, why don't you want to completely forget and start over?"
"Forgot?" Ning Ranran raised her head suddenly, tears welling up in her eyes, crystal clear, but she forced them not to fall. Her long eyelashes trembled slightly, like a butterfly fluttering its wings.
She looked at Yue Linhan's ethereal figure, which seemed to be blown away by the wind at any time. Her voice was a little choked, but also revealed a little bit of unquestionable determination, "Will Ning Ranran still be Ning Ranran if he has forgotten everything in his previous life? He is just a stranger with an empty body."
"Yes, I admit that there are indeed not many happy memories in my past life. Those days were as painful as soaking in coptis water." Ning Ranran's eyes were burning, she looked directly at him, and spoke loudly every word, "But so what? It's those broken, painful, and even unbearable pasts., only then pieced together the unique me. I am the one who has all the memories, and this is the real Ning Ranran. "
Yue Linhan looked at her quietly, her bottomless eyes filled with complex emotions that Ning Ranran couldn't understand, like compassion, heartache, and a trace of indescribable guilt.
After a while, he slowly stretched out his hand. It was obviously just an insubstantial shadow, and his fingertips penetrated the broken hair on her forehead. She couldn't feel any real touch, but Ning Ranran's heart felt strangely warm, as if there was really a warm palm gently covering the top of her head.
Yue Linhan's expression was tainted with a touch of sadness, and her always cold eyes seemed to be covered with a layer of frost and snow at this moment. His voice was low and hoarse, as if coming from the depths of distant time: "I'm sorry... It was all my negligence that made you suffer in this strange world, alone and helpless for so many years. "
Ning Ranran's eyes widened suddenly, her pupils shrank slightly, and she was so shocked that she almost forgot to breathe, her lips moved, and it took her a long time to find her voice: "You...what do you mean by this? do you know me? Did you know me before I came to Douluo Continent? "
Yue Linhan nodded gently, and the expression on her pale face became softer and softer, with a hint of reminiscence: "Eighty years ago, I had a premonition that my divine power was gradually eroding, and the reincarnation of heaven was inevitable. I was born in accordance with the destiny, and I should die in accordance with the destiny. Until one day, I suddenly received a revelation from heaven while in retreat. It said that I still had a period of unfinished cause and effect, and I needed to find a successor to take over my divine status and end this earthly relationship. "
"I have used the sky-gazing mirror to look around all the worlds, and have seen countless people's births, old age, sickness and death, joys and sorrows, but I have never found the suitable heir. "Yue Linhan's voice flowed slowly, carrying the vicissitudes of time.
"It wasn't until that day that my best friend came to visit and saw me looking at the sky mirror all day long with a frown on my face. He casually said, 'It's better to search for yourself than search thousands of miles away.' Only then did I wake up from the situation I was trapped in. So... I decided to take away one of my ribs. "
"I placed that rib on the lotus platform for nourishing the soul, watered it with my heart essence and blood every day, and then carefully cultivated it with my life-long spiritual power. This cultivation lasted for fifty years. "Yue Linhan's eyes fell on Ning Ranran's face, with an almost tender affection, "Until..."
His words paused slightly, and Ning Ranran's heart also lifted. Yue Linhan looked at her calmly with his eyes, which were so deep that he seemed to be able to see through her soul. Ning Ranran's heart seemed to be clenched by an invisible hand, and it stopped beating at that moment, and even her breathing became stagnant.
